title: what do we all feel about the mall world?
content: ive been having these dreams for 3 years now. i remember my very first one, i was in the process of passing a kidney stone, lol. in that dream, I had a side kick, a mini-pony named thomasz. obviously I went and got him as soon as i could after the dream. at the time i was just like “woah, cool dream.” but then I was dreaming of the same places every night. some nights i’d go somewhere new, but to me it is blatantly obvious it’s all in the same world. i felt like i broke a barrier by getting the horse, like i was linked with the dream world. I’ve always had pretty vivid dreams, albeit irregularily. i tried lucid dreaming when a preteen but i never actually did it. these dreams exhaust me. but I love them. I have trouble remembering big themes or story lines from the dreams, but when i’m awake and am reminded of something in the dream, i feel tethered in a way? like the other night i dreamt of a drill bit, the next day I saw it sitting there and i felt like i could see into the dream? just around the drill bit? idk. before i found this thread, i’d spend hours awake at night between dreams trying to identify what was causing it. hormones? planetary aspects? idk. i was just so exhausted but excited to go back. what makes the dreams stronger or weaker for you all? do you feel like there is a hidden meaning or agenda behind it all? because it feels so real, i have trouble gaining any control over myself in the dream. what tactics do you use to help yourself realize its a dream? everything is always so frantic i can never get a second to assess the situation. idk. just hoping for commentary because no matter how often i explain this to irls they do not get the magnitude of it all. i dont want to wake up refreshed, I want to know what is going on
